description: Engine §4: filtered and unfiltered forest tags of one forest keep separate answers, unfiltered first.

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage before
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text $w:word $b:bad
%emits $w :: X, $b :: X
%rule word A
%rule bad A
%error "bad"
%stage last
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text X X
%conditions (Dirty ⊆ $.parse(word).tags) ∧ (Dirty ⊈ $.parse(word).error-free.tags) ∧ (Clean ⊆ $.parse(word).error-free.tags)
%rule word
  | X X :: Dirty
  | X junk :: Clean
%rule junk X
%erased
```
